instruction: We keep hitting the same database connection-pool exhaustion during traffic spikes. Capture the fix so the next on-call doesn't rediscover it. Create a wiki page in the Engineering space titled 'DB Connection Pool Exhaustion Runbook' whose body documents the concrete remediation: raise the pool max size and recycle idle connections, and mention checking pgbouncer. Then move the related Linear issue ENG-6 'Refactor database connection pooling' to In Review since this runbook unblocks it, and tell #engineering the runbook is up and name ENG-6.
instruction_zh: 我们在流量高峰期间反复遇到同样的数据库连接池耗尽问题。请记录下修复方案，以免下一位值班同事重新摸索。在 Engineering 空间创建一个标题为 'DB Connection Pool Exhaustion Runbook' 的 wiki 页面，正文记录具体的修复措施：提高连接池最大大小、回收空闲连接，并提及检查 pgbouncer。然后将相关的 Linear 工单 ENG-6 'Refactor database connection pooling' 移至 In Review 状态，因为这份运行手册为其扫清了障碍；并在 #engineering 频道告知大家运行手册已发布，同时提及 ENG-6。
persona: You are an office worker acting as a technical writer. Your tools for this task are: the team wiki, the Linear issue tracker, team communications.
context: Initial environment (seeded via a single shared session id across all mocks): a team wiki with Engineering/Product spaces and pages; Linear workspace (32 issues across Engineering/Design teams); Slack workspace with channels #general, #engineering, #random. GROUND TRUTH — the agent earns partial credit for each checkpoint: new pool-exhaustion runbook page (+0.3); runbook body has concrete remediation (pool + pgbouncer) (+0.25); ENG-6 moved to In Review (+0.25); slack_new_msg (+0.1); Slack names ENG-6 (+0.1). Scoring is absolute over each mock's current_state; new objects exclude the seeded IDs, so an untouched environment scores 0.0 and fully completing every checkpoint scores 1.0.
